g.text: Interactive Session — Deep Mode Iterative Discovery
user@org:~$
"Our furniture store sells well, but salespeople hoard customer info because commission
rewards individual performance. Help me find innovative ways to improve teamwork without removing commission."
● AGENT (Turn 1 Restraint — 380 tokens)
System & Preservation Scan: Core contradiction: Individual commission incentive vs. shared customer handoff.
Non-negotiable anchor: Customer ownership & sales credit remain intact ($0 added store payroll).
Quarantined Tropes: Team commission pool, mandatory CRM compliance software, management bonuses.
Discovery Questions (4 targeted):
1. Who handles returning walk-ins when the original salesperson is off? 2. Are custom room quotes paper or digital?
Provisional Seeds: Seed A (Asymmetric Assist Fee), Seed B (Up-Queue Podium Immunity), Seed C (Back-of-Tag Notes).
user@org:~$
"Customer ownership must remain 100%. Days-off coverage is the main failure. Managers can change floor rules."
● AGENT (Six-Layer Innovation Portfolio Generated)
P1 [Incentive Unbundling]
Preparedness Split: 90% Owner / 10% Covering Rep if CRM card pre-filled; 75/25 if cold handoff.
P2 [Queue Priority]
Up-Queue Immunity: Covering a teammate freezes your #1 door rotation spot. Zero walk-in penalty.
P3 [Information Schema]
Open Handoff Dossier: 3-item physical tag on bestselling sectional frames credits Category Curators.
P4 [Role Separation]
Owner-Triggered Micro-Assists: Fixed 10-minute second-voice closing assist without commission dilution.
Rickards Ch. 8 Receptivity:
Rule of Three Hearings (Closer, Covering Rep, Sales Manager) inoculates against "Yes, but..." pushback.
1-2 Week Low-Cost Probe:
5-day Paper Handoff Card trial on Sectionals before making software changes. Fully reversible.
